GFX and sound: G1–G10 (2026-10-23)

  • Captured with Playwright (Chromium, SwiftShader WebGL2) against the build before the change (HEAD a80068a, port 5101) and after (https://localhost:5001), on the same Azurite data: three seeded repositories (300, 140 and 45 days of history).
  • Transient effects were triggered by calling the same fx.* entry points the pages call, since a real analysis cannot be timed for a screenshot.
  • Not visible in pictures (G2, sound): each progress frame ticks a pentatonic note pitched by lines per commit; completion plays the repository’s own chord (its top three file types pick the notes), failure a detuned falling fifth. Odometer clicks, the milestone fanfare, ember rumble, fireworks pops, the year chord and the disintegration whoosh are all synthesised. All of it is silent unless the header’s sound toggle is on.
  • All motion is off under prefers-reduced-motion, and localStorage.fx = 'off' turns the visual effects off.

Repositories: aurora backdrop, liquid-glass tiles, odometer numbers (G4, G5, G10)

The backdrop is now a domain-warped aurora whose speed and warmth come from the last 30 days (active days, lines added vs. size). KPI tiles are glass that refracts the aurora at its rim (Chromium) and carry a pointer highlight. Numbers sit on odometer reels: they look identical at rest and roll digit by digit when they change.

Analysis in progress: the commit river (G1)

Driven by calling fx.progress with a frame’s deltas. Each progress frame streams particles in the repository’s file-type colours from its row into the Total Lines tile, which glows as they land. Dark theme blends additively.

Analysis finished: supernova (G3)

A shockwave ring refracts the backdrop from the row (chromatic edge), sparks flash, and confetti scaled by repository size flips in 3D, bounces on the tops of the cards and settles.

Insights: streak flame (G10)

The current-streak tile gets a turbulence-displaced flame that is taller the longer the streak (full at 30 days). The digest banner’s streak gets the same flame.

Hotspots: heat haze and embers (G6)

The seeded repositories have no clone on the server, so the treemap is empty here. The red block is a stand-in tile carrying the same data-heat="4" and haze filter the hottest real tiles get: its edges shimmer, and hovering sheds embers (with a low rumble when sound is on).

Share tab: holographic badge plate (G8)

The live badges sit on a foil plate that tilts toward the pointer on a spring, with a rainbow band and glare that follow it (device tilt on Android).

Year in Review: the year as a 3D city (G7)

One instanced tower per day on the contribution-calendar grid, rising on a spring through the year. Glass fresnel rims, lit windows, glow over the busiest days, a procedural ground grid. The camera flies to each slide’s subject (here the 15th of the busiest month). The summary slide fires fireworks and plays a 12-note “year chord” whose loudness per note is that month’s commits, and its card tilts as foil. The downloaded PNG is unchanged.

Delete account: disintegration (G9)

Only after the server confirms the deletion: the card erodes through a noise mask while dust drifts off it, over a low whoosh and a sub thump, and then the page goes to sign-in. Captured here by calling fx.disintegrate on the card without deleting anything.
